claims.text: Context building heights use sparse OpenStreetMap level counts and documented footprint-area visual-massing defaults; none are official heights.
Road and railway widths are visualization conventions, not surveyed or official physical widths.

reviewIssues.description: This package contains neighborhood context only. It contains no proposal features or proposal-plan georeference.
Context layers have different source vintages. The baseline date records package verification, not a claim that every feature was observed that day.
